name: CSN 7353 TCAS机动 危险品 延误/加油

cards.audioText:
your call sign is CSN 7353, a flight from Wuhan to Los Angeles, the cargo manifest shows that there is forbidden goods on board, report it to company operations and request offload the luggage.
forbidden goods/prohibited goods
cards.audioTextZh:
你的呼号是 CSN 7353，这是一趟从武汉飞往洛杉矶的航班，货舱单显示机上有禁运品，向公司运行部门报告并请求卸下行李。
禁运品/违禁品
cards.referenceText: Dispatch, CSN 7353, cargo manifest shows, forbidden goods, request offload the luggage.
cards.referenceTextZh: 签派，CSN 7353，货舱单显示有禁运品，请求卸下行李。

cards.audioText: Now you are at Gate 23, you have got information N, request ATC clearance to Los Angeles from Wuhan Delivery.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你位于 23 登机口，已收到 N 情报，向武汉放行申请前往洛杉矶的 ATC 放行许可。
cards.referenceText: Delivery, CSN 7353, Gate 23, information N, request ATC clearance, Los Angeles
cards.referenceTextZh: 放行，CSN 7353，23 登机口，N 情报，申请前往洛杉矶的 ATC 放行许可。

cards.audioText: CSN 7353, cleared to Los Angeles via flight planned route, Runway 36R, LKO01 DAL Departure, initial climb 1,200 meters, cruising level 8,900 meters, departure frequency 119.7, squawk 2515.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 7353，许可按飞行计划航路飞往洛杉矶，Runway 36R，执行 LKO-01 DAL 离场，初始爬升至 1,200 米，巡航高度 8,900 米，离场频率 119.7，应答机 2515。
cards.referenceText: cleared to Los Angeles, flight planned route, Runway 36R, LKO-01 departure, 1200 meters, 8900 meters, 119.7, squawk 2515, CSN 7353.
cards.referenceTextZh: 许可按飞行计划航路飞往洛杉矶，Runway 36R，执行 LKO-01 离场，初始爬升至 1200 米，巡航高度 8900 米，119.7，应答机 2515，CSN 7353。

cards.audioText: CSN 7353, expect 15 minutes delay, the airport is temporarily closed due heavy fog. Call you back.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 7353，预计延误 15 分钟，因大雾机场暂时关闭。稍后呼叫你。
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，预计延误 15 分钟，CSN 7353。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are ready for push back and start up.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你准备好推出和开车。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CSN 7353, request push back and start up.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CSN 7353，请求推出和开车。

cards.audioText: CSN 7353, after traffic taxiing behind is clear, push back and startup approved, push back onto taxiway Z4, abeam Gate 232, facing East.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 7353，后方滑行航空器通过后，推出和开车批准，向后推出至 Z4 滑行道，与 232 登机口平行，机头朝东。
cards.referenceText: after traffic is clear, push back and startup approved, push back onto taxiway Z four, abeam Gate 232, facing East, CSN 7353.
cards.referenceTextZh: 相关航空器通过后，推出和开车批准，向后推出至 Z4 滑行道，与 232 登机口平行，机头朝东，CSN 7353。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are on taxiway Z4, you are ready for taxi.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你在滑行道 Z4，准备好滑行。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CSN 7353, taxiway Z4, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CSN 7353，滑行道 Z4，请求滑行。

cards.audioText: CSN 7353, taxi via taxiway Z4, A3 and A to holding point Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 7353，经 Z4、A3 和 A 滑行道滑行至 Runway 36R 等待点。
cards.referenceText: taxi via taxiway Z four, A four and A, holding point Runway 36R, CSN 7353.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经 Z4、A4 和 A 滑行道滑行至 Runway 36R 等待点，CSN 7353。

cards.audioText: during taxi, the visibility is getting worse due to heavy fog, you are unable to taxi, tell the controller that you will hold at present position until visibility gets better.
cards.audioTextZh: 滑行期间，因大雾能见度持续恶化，你无法滑行，告诉管制员你将在当前位置等待，直至能见度改善。
cards.referenceText: Ground, CSN 7353, visibility, getting worse, heavy fog, unable to taxi, request hold at present position, until visibility gets better.
cards.referenceTextZh: 地面，CSN 7353，能见度因大雾持续恶化，无法滑行，请求在当前位置等待，直至能见度改善。

cards.audioText: CSN 7353, the visibility is improving, continue taxi to holding point Runway 36R via taxiway A3 and A.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 7353，能见度正在改善，经 A3 和 A 滑行道继续滑行至 Runway 36R 等待点。
cards.referenceText: taxi to holding point Runway 36R via taxiway A tree, A, CSN 7353.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经 A3 和 A 滑行道滑行至 Runway 36R 等待点，CSN 7353。

cards.audioText: now you are at holding point Runway 36R, you are ready for departure, contact Wuhan Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你位于 Runway 36R 等待点，已准备好离场，联系武汉塔台。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CSN 7353, holding point Runway 36R, ready for departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CSN 7353，Runway 36R 等待点，已准备好离场。

cards.audioText: CSN 7353, Runway 36R, cleared for takeoff, when airborne, contact 119.7.
B: Now you are airborne, passing 1200 meters, contact Departure.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你已离地，正通过 1200 米，联系离场。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, CSN 7353, airborne, passing 1200 meters.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，CSN 7353，已离地，通过 1200 米。

cards.audioText: CSN 7353, Wuhan Departure, radar contact, climb to 3,900 meters at 3000 feet per minute or greater.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 7353，武汉离场，雷达识别，以每分钟 3000 英尺或更大的爬升率爬升至 3,900 米。
cards.referenceText: climb to 3900 meters, at 3000 feet per minute or greater, CSN 7353.
cards.referenceTextZh: 以每分钟 3000 英尺或更大的爬升率爬升至 3900 米，CSN 7353。

cards.audioText: CSN 7353, continue climb to 8,900 meters, report passing 6,000 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 7353，继续爬升至 8,900 米，通过 6,000 米时报告。
